headline: Strategic Base Fighting Shifts Across Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Callahan’s Passage has swung from an eight-to-two Warden lead to all ten strategic bases under Warden ownership, despite six recorded events in the latest two hours. The sector remains heavily engaged, with 522 Colonial and 441 Warden casualties in that watch, though both casualty rates are cooling. Fisherman’s Row has gone quiet over the last two hours but remains the busiest recent turnover front, with 14 events in six hours and 45 across the day. Weathered Expanse reports five events in two hours and 40 in 24, while Stlican Shelf has four and 25 respectively; both retain divided ownership. Deadlands has seen no fresh turnover in two hours, yet six events in six hours leave its four-Warden, seven-Colonial ledger unsettled. Stonecradle has newly entered the active list with three events in two hours, alongside sharp casualty totals and all nine bases currently Warden-held. Oarbreaker also records fresh action, but the principal ownership-change watch now lies across these six fronts.
